title: Salt++: Context-Aligned Post-Training for Few-Step Streaming Multimodal Generation
title_zh: Salt++：面向少步流式多模态生成的上下文对齐后训练

paragraphs.en: Few-step streaming audio–video generation requires both causal modeling and step distillation, yet standard training recipes face two context-related challenges. Teacher forcing pairs clean history with a noisy target, but supervises predictive contextual representations only indirectly through velocity prediction. Meanwhile, directly reusing bidirectional score models in causal Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) creates a mismatch between generation and scoring contexts. We address these challenges with Salt++ , a two-stage post-training framework comprising Causal Self-Flow (CSF) and context-aligned autoregressive DMD. CSF exploits contextual information asymmetry by varying the history while keeping the noisy target fixed: a noise-mixed-history student aligns its intermediate representations with those of a clean-history exponential-moving-average teacher. This self-supervised signal encourages the student to extract semantic information and improves cross-modal alignment. Context-aligned AR DMD shares the causal mask and prefix across generator sampling, fake-score training, and real-score evaluation to match generated and reference distributions under a block-conditional KL objective. With calibrated teacher guidance, it performs clean-prefix few-step distillation and then adapts to generated histories without switching objectives or requiring separate consistency distillation. At 480p, Salt++ improves visual and motion quality by 57% and 45% over OmniForcing on JavisBench under the same 4-step causal setting. A separate scale-wise post-training stage extends Salt++ to 4-step 1664 × 960 1664\times 960 generation, outperforming bidirectional LTX-2 on six of seven reported metrics. Project page: https://xingtongge.github.io/Saltpp .
paragraphs.zh: 少步数的流式音视频生成同时需要因果建模和步数蒸馏，然而标准的训练配方面临两个与上下文相关的挑战。 教师强制将干净的历史与带噪声的目标配对，但只能通过速度预测间接地监督预测性的上下文表示。 同时，在因果分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）中直接复用双向分数模型，会造成生成上下文与打分上下文之间的不匹配。 我们提出 Salt++ 来应对这些挑战，这是一个包含因果自流（CSF）和上下文对齐自回归 DMD 的两阶段后训练框架。 CSF 通过在保持带噪声目标不变的同时改变历史，来利用上下文信息的不对称性：一个噪声混合历史的学生模型使其中间表示与干净历史的指数移动平均教师模型的中间表示对齐。 这种自监督信号促使学生模型提取语义信息，并改善跨模态对齐。 上下文对齐的自回归 DMD 在生成器采样、假分数训练和真实分数评估之间共享因果掩码和前缀，以便在块条件 KL 目标下匹配生成分布和参考分布。 借助经过校准的教师引导，它先进行干净前缀的少步数蒸馏，随后适应生成的历史，而无需切换目标或需要单独的一致性蒸馏。 在 480p 分辨率下，在 JavisBench 上相同的 4 步因果设置下，Salt++ 相比 OmniForcing 将视觉质量和运动质量分别提升了 57% 和 45%。 一个单独的逐尺度后训练阶段将 Salt++ 扩展到 4 步 1664 × 960 1664\times 960 生成，在七项报告指标中的六项上超越了双向的 LTX-2。 项目页面：https://xingtongge.github.io/Saltpp 。

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation models ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) can synthesize increasingly realistic scenes, and unified audio–video models ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Chern et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ) further produce sound, speech, and visual content within a single diffusion process. Yet two properties put them at odds with real-time interaction. These models must generate an entire clip before displaying any output due to temporally bidirectional architectures, while modeling instantaneous velocity fields typically requires multi-step ODE integration for high-quality sampling, which is slow and expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成模型（Yang et al., 2025；Kong et al., 2024；Wan et al., 2025；Gao et al., 2025）能够合成日益逼真的场景，而统一的音频-视频模型（HaCohen et al., 2026；Chern et al., 2026；Team et al., 2025；Seedance et al., 2026）则能在单一扩散过程中进一步生成声音、语音和视觉内容。 然而有两个特性使它们与实时交互相冲突。 由于采用时间上双向的架构，这些模型必须在展示任何输出之前生成完整的片段；同时，对瞬时速度场的建模通常需要多步 ODE 积分才能实现高质量采样，这既缓慢又昂贵。

paragraphs.en: Removing both costs asks for progress along two separate dimensions. The first is causal modeling : autoregressive (AR) generation replaces temporally bidirectional attention with block-causal attention ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026b ) , so that each block is produced conditioned only on preceding ones and output can stream with bounded latency. The second is step distillation : the sampling trajectory is compressed to a few evaluations while preserving the quality of the bidirectional teacher. However, prevailing recipes pursue the two dimensions through a long pipeline that changes objective at every stage—a causal teacher obtained by teacher forcing, a few-step generator initialized from it by ODE matching or consistency distillation, and a final refinement by distribution matching on the generator’s own rollouts ( Lin et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; Fig. 1 lays these out.
paragraphs.zh: 同时消除这两项开销需要在两个独立的维度上取得进展。 第一个维度是因果建模：自回归（AR）生成用块因果注意力取代时间上双向的注意力（Yin et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2026；Ge et al., 2026b），使得每个块仅以先前的块为条件生成，并且输出能够以有界时延进行流式传输。 第二个维度是步数蒸馏：在保持双向教师模型质量的同时，将采样轨迹压缩到少数几次求值。 然而，主流的做法通过一条在每个阶段都改变目标的漫长流水线来追求这两个维度——先通过教师强制得到一个因果教师模型，再通过 ODE 匹配或一致性蒸馏从它初始化得到一个少步生成器，最后在生成器自身的 rollout 上通过分布匹配进行最终精炼（Lin et al., 2025b；Zhao et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2026）；图 1 对这些步骤做了展示。

paragraphs.en: These two dimensions raise distinct challenges concerning causal context. First, causal modeling requires extracting semantic information from past audio–video blocks that is predictive of the current block. Teacher forcing provides clean history alongside a noisy target, yet standard flow matching learns contextual representations only indirectly through velocity prediction. The challenge is to turn the information asymmetry into a direct learning signal for predictive contextual representations. Second, block-conditional Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) requires generation and score estimation to share the same conditioning context. Evaluating score models with bidirectional context for blocks generated under a causal prefix introduces a score–context mismatch , misaligning the score estimates with the intended block-conditional objective.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个维度在因果上下文方面带来了不同的挑战。 首先，因果建模需要从过去的音视频块中提取对当前块具有预测性的语义信息。 教师强制提供了干净的历史信息与含噪目标，然而标准流匹配只能通过速度预测间接地学习上下文表示。 挑战在于将这种信息不对称转化为对预测性上下文表示的直接学习信号。 其次，基于块条件的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin et al., 2024b; Yin et al., 2024a）要求生成与得分估计共享相同的条件上下文。 对在因果前缀下生成的块使用具有双向上下文的得分模型进行评估，会引入得分–上下文不匹配，使得分估计与预期的块条件目标不一致。

paragraphs.en: We address the first challenge with Causal Self-Flow (CSF). Motivated by semantic representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , we adapt Self-Flow’s asymmetric-view learning ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) to causal audio–video generation. A student observes a noise-mixed history, while an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher observes the corresponding clean history; both receive the same noisy target block. Alongside the native flow-matching objective, we align projected features from a shallow student layer with features from a deeper EMA-teacher layer, both extracted from the same noisy target block. By placing the input asymmetry entirely in the history, CSF encourages the student to recover clean-context features from partially corrupted history and learn contextual representations that support next-block prediction. Empirically, CSF improves audio–visual and audio–text alignment during causal teacher training (Fig. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们用因果自流（Causal Self-Flow, CSF）来解决第一个挑战。 受语义表征对齐（Yu et al., 2025）的启发，我们将 Self-Flow 的非对称视图学习（Chefer et al., 2026）适配到因果音视频生成中。 学生模型观测的是混合噪声的历史，而指数移动平均（EMA）教师模型观测的是对应的干净历史；两者接收同一个带噪声的目标块。 在原生的流匹配目标之外，我们将学生模型浅层的投影特征与 EMA 教师模型更深层的特征对齐，二者均从同一个带噪声的目标块中提取。 通过将输入的非对称性完全置于历史中，CSF 促使学生模型从部分受损的历史中恢复干净上下文特征，并学习支持下一块预测的上下文表征。 从实验上看，CSF 在因果教师训练期间改善了音视频与音文本的对齐（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: We address the second challenge with context-aligned AR DMD . Generator sampling, fake-score training, and real-score evaluation share the same block-causal mask and audio–video prefix. The fake score therefore estimates the distribution induced by the causal generator under that prefix, while the real score represents the corresponding conditional data distribution, making resulting update an estimator of the gradient of a block-conditional KL objective. With aligned contexts and calibrated teacher guidance, DMD directly performs strong few-step distillation, replacing the separate ODE-matching or consistency-distillation stage used by prevailing recipes. We then adapt to generated histories while retaining the same objective, unifying clean-prefix distillation and on-policy adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过上下文对齐的 AR DMD 来应对第二个挑战。 生成器采样、假分数训练和真分数评估共享相同的块级因果掩码和音频–视频前缀。 因此，假分数估计的是因果生成器在该前缀下诱导出的分布，而真分数表示相应的条件数据分布，这使得所得到的更新成为块级条件 KL 目标函数梯度的一个估计量。 在对齐的上下文和经过校准的教师引导下，DMD 能够直接进行强大的少步蒸馏，取代了主流方案中单独使用的 ODE 匹配或一致性蒸馏阶段。 随后我们在保持相同目标的前提下适配已生成的历史，从而统一了干净前缀蒸馏与在线策略适配。

paragraphs.en: Audio–video generation and representation alignment. Joint audio–video diffusion models synthesize both modalities within a shared generative process. Existing systems explore hierarchical spatio-temporal priors, asymmetric or single-stream cross-modal interaction, and large-scale training ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Low et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Chern et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ) . We build on bidirectional LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) to obtain causal few-step generation. For representation learning, REPA aligns model features with an external visual encoder ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , while Self-Flow uses cleaner features from an EMA branch ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) . CSF adapts the latter principle to causal audio–video history, aligning a noise-mixed-history student with a clean-history EMA teacher under the same noisy target.
paragraphs.zh: 音视频生成与表征对齐。 音视频联合扩散模型在共享的生成过程中同时合成两种模态。 现有系统探索了层次化时空先验、非对称或单流跨模态交互以及大规模训练（ Liu et al., 2025 ; Low et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Chern et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ）。 我们基于双向的 LTX-2（ HaCohen et al., 2026 ）构建，以实现因果的少步生成。 在表征学习方面，REPA 将模型特征与外部视觉编码器对齐（ Yu et al., 2025 ），而 Self-Flow 则使用来自 EMA 分支的更干净特征（ Chefer et al., 2026 ）。 CSF 将后者的原理适配到因果音视频历史上，在相同的噪声目标下，将混合噪声历史的学生模型与干净历史的 EMA 教师模型对齐。

paragraphs.en: Few-step distillation and autoregressive generation. Few-step generation commonly relies on trajectory or score based distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , with DMD extending to large scale image and video models ( Ge et al., 2026a ; Ge et al., 2026b ) . Autoregressive diffusion models generate temporal blocks sequentially under causal conditioning ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ) . Recent methods combine causal generation with few-step distillation: CausVid distills bidirectional models into causal generators ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , Self Forcing and AAPT adapt students on previously generated frames ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025b ) , while Causal Forcing variants and Causal-rCM separate teacher-forced initialization from on-policy refinement ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent CMD similarly uses causal DMD ( Bandyopadhyay et al., 2026 ) , but studies video-only distillation and moves directly to on-policy rollouts. We differ in three respects: we isolate the effect of score context in a controlled teacher-forced comparison, we show that the teacher guidance scale must be recalibrated for distribution matching rather than inherited from consistency distillation, and we obtain the AR teacher itself through a representation-alignment objective for joint audio–video generation.

paragraphs.en: As a further extension, we build on the 4-step streaming generator obtained in Sec. 3.3 to enable high-resolution generation. Specifically, we train the generator itself to perform both low-resolution (LR) generation and high-resolution (HR) refinement, allocating two denoising steps to each scale.

paragraphs.en: Chunk-wise cross-scale generation. For each temporal block, the generator first performs two LR evaluations to produce a clean audio–video prediction. A causal latent upsampler U ω U_{\omega} then spatially upsamples the video latent using only the current block and a bounded history window, while the audio latent retains its resolution. Both modalities are re-noised to initialize two HR evaluations, after which the completed block is output before proceeding to the next block. During both training rollouts and inference, the generator shares parameters across scales but maintains separate LR and HR KV caches, each containing the corresponding audio–video history. The scales communicate through the latent transition. We initialize U ω U_{\omega} by distilling the released LTX-2 latent upsampler into this windowed causal form. This block-wise procedure preserves causal streaming while producing 1664 × 960 1664\times 960 output with four generator evaluations per block.

paragraphs.en: Models and baselines. We build Salt++ on LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) , using LTX-2 Base as a multi-step reference and OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026 ) as the 4-step causal baseline. paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol. We evaluate on the 1,000 JavisBench-mini prompts ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and a fixed set of their LTX-2 prompt-enhancer (PE) rewrites, shared across models. At 480p, videos contain 121 frames at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 24 FPS. We report JavisBench quality, semantic alignment, and synchronization metrics, alongside four VBench Huang et al. paragraphs.en: We presented Salt++, a context-aligned post-training framework for few-step streaming audio–video generation. Causal Self-Flow strengthens contextual learning in the AR teacher, while context-aligned AR DMD conditions the generator and both score models on the same causal prefix and keeps that objective as the prefix changes from ground truth to generated rollouts. Once the conditional paths agree, distribution matching is well posed enough to serve as the primary few-step objective, removing the separate consistency-distillation stage of prevailing recipes. The resulting 4-step generator improves visual and motion quality by 57% and 45% over OmniForcing at 480p, and scale-wise post-training reaches 1664 × 960 1664\times 960 within the same budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Salt++，一个面向少步流式音视频生成的上下文对齐后训练框架。 因果自流（Causal Self-Flow）增强了 AR 教师模型中的上下文学习，而上下文对齐的 AR DMD 则使生成器和两个分数模型都条件于相同的因果前缀，并在该前缀从真实数据变为生成 rollout 的过程中始终保持这一目标。 一旦条件路径达成一致，分布匹配就足够适定，可以作为主要的少步目标，从而省去主流方法中单独的一致性蒸馏阶段。 所得到的 4 步生成器在 480p 下相比 OmniForcing 将视觉质量与运动质量分别提升了 57% 和 45%，并且按规模扩展的后训练在相同预算内达到了 1664 × 960 1664\times 960。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate joint text-to-audio–video generation on the 1,000 prompts of JavisBench-mini ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , covering diverse visual events and sound sources. The official track uses the released joint prompts and evaluator. Every model generates one sample per prompt with seed 12,345 + i 12{,}345+i for sample index i i ; video and audio are evaluated from H.264 MP4 and PCM WAV outputs. To test sensitivity to prompt formulation, we also construct a fixed rewrite track by applying the official LTX-2 prompt enhancer ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) once to each joint prompt with rewrite seed 42. The resulting 1,000 longer prompts are shared across models, rather than rewritten separately for each system.

paragraphs.en: The official main comparison reports visual quality (VQ), motion quality (MQ), audio quality (AQ), CLIP text–video agreement, ImageBind audio–visual agreement (IB-AV), JavisScore, and DeSync (lower is better). These distinguish perceptual quality from semantic agreement and temporal synchronization. We additionally report VBench aesthetic quality, imaging quality, subject consistency, and background consistency on the same 480p generations. These consistency measurements concern the evaluated clips, not extended rollouts. The initialization analysis includes ImageBind text–video (IB-TV) and text–audio (IB-TA) agreement, while the causal-teacher analysis also uses AVHScore and CLAP. AV-Align is excluded because of its evaluation cost. The rewrite track reports VQ, MQ, AQ, IB-AV, AVHScore, JavisScore, and DeSync; we omit text-dependent metrics because the longer joint rewrites may exceed the encoders’ text contexts and do not provide separately rewritten audio and video descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 官方主对比报告了视觉质量（VQ）、运动质量（MQ）、音频质量（AQ）、CLIP 文本–视频一致性、ImageBind 音频–视觉一致性（IB-AV）、JavisScore 和 DeSync（数值越低越好）。 这些指标将感知质量与语义一致性以及时间同步区分开来。 我们还在相同的 480p 生成结果上报告了 VBench 的美学质量、成像质量、主体一致性和背景一致性。 这些一致性度量针对的是被评估的片段，而不是扩展的生成序列。 初始化分析包括 ImageBind 文本–视频（IB-TV）和文本–音频（IB-TA）一致性，而因果教师分析还使用了 AVHScore 和 CLAP。 由于评估成本的原因，AV-Align 未被纳入。 重写赛道报告了 VQ、MQ、AQ、IB-AV、AVHScore、JavisScore 和 DeSync；我们省略了依赖文本的指标，因为较长的联合重写可能超出编码器的文本上下文，并且没有提供单独重写的音频和视频描述。

paragraphs.en: DeSync estimates the temporal offset between an audio track and a video track, without assessing the quality of either. A configuration whose video is nearly static therefore offers little motion for the synchronization model to misalign and can record a low DeSync while producing visually uninformative output. This is the case for the BI–AR row of Tab. 3 (a): it attains the best DeSync in that table at 0.531 0.531 , but reaches only 1.131 1.131 VQ and 0.157 0.157 MQ, far below the aligned AR–AR configuration at 3.147 3.147 and 1.351 1.351 . We therefore read DeSync together with VQ and MQ rather than in isolation, and treat it as informative only among configurations that produce comparable motion.
paragraphs.zh: DeSync 估计音轨与视频轨之间的时间偏移，而不评估任一轨的质量。 因此，视频几乎静止的配置为同步模型提供的可错位运动很少，可能在产生视觉上无信息量的输出的同时记录到较低的 DeSync。 表 3 (a) 中的 BI–AR 行就是这种情况：它在该表中取得了最好的 DeSync，为 0.531 0.531，但仅达到 1.131 1.131 的 VQ 和 0.157 0.157 的 MQ，远低于 3.147 3.147 和 1.351 1.351 的对齐 AR–AR 配置。 因此，我们将 DeSync 与 VQ 和 MQ 结合起来解读，而非孤立看待，并且仅在产生可比较运动的配置之间将其视为有信息量的指标。

paragraphs.en: LTX-2 Base ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) is the bidirectional foundation-model reference; the CSF AR teacher measures causal generation before step reduction. OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026 ) is the released 4-step causal baseline. At 480p, Salt++ is evaluated through two complete routes, initialized by either TF-dCM or context-aligned AR–AR TF-DMD and then refined on generated contexts. Thus, a route in the main comparison includes rollout refinement, whereas an initializer in the ablations does not. We generate 832 × 480 832\times 480 videos with 121 frames at 24 FPS, approximately five seconds. The LTX-2 VAE compresses video temporally by 8 × 8\times , so the block-causal layout pairs three video latent frames with 25 audio latent frames per one-second block; the first block additionally carries the initial latent frame of each stream, and a 121-frame clip therefore forms K = 5 K=5 blocks. The AR teacher uses 40-step Euler sampling with video and audio CFG both set to 4.0. The Salt++ initializers and rollout models use the 4-step grid [ 1000,960,889,727 , 0 ] [1000,960,889,727,0] and inference CFG = 1 =1 , predicting a clean endpoint and re-noising it to the next grid point at each step. Both this grid and the finer eight-point grid from which training noise levels are drawn (Appendix A.5 ) are images of uniform partitions of [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] under the same shift t ↦ 8 ​ t / ( 1 + 7 ​ t ) t\mapsto 8t/(1+7t) used during training, so the former is a subset of the latter. At 960p, the scale-wise system uses 2 low-resolution and 2 high-resolution generator evaluations. LTX-2 uses its 40 + 3 40+3 -step high-resolution path. OmniForcing is evaluated by directly applying its released checkpoint to the 960p token grid; this is a resolution-extrapolation diagnostic, not a resolution-matched trained baseline.
paragraphs.zh: LTX-2 Base（HaCohen 等，2026）是双向基础模型的参考基准；CSF AR 教师则用于在步数削减之前衡量因果生成能力。 OmniForcing（Su 等，2026）是已发布的 4 步因果基线。 在 480p 下，Salt++ 通过两条完整路线进行评估，分别由 TF-dCM 或上下文对齐的 AR–AR TF-DMD 初始化，然后在生成的上下文上进行精炼。 因此，主对比中的路线包含 rollout 精炼，而消融实验中的初始化器则不包含。 我们生成 832 × 480 832\times 480 的视频，共 121 帧，帧率为 24 FPS，时长大约五秒。 LTX-2 VAE 在时间上对视频进行 8 × 8\times 压缩，因此块因果布局将每个一秒块中的 3 个视频潜变量帧与 25 个音频潜变量帧配对；第一个块还额外携带每个流的初始潜变量帧，因此一个 121 帧的片段形成 K = 5 K=5 个块。 AR 教师使用 40 步 Euler 采样，视频和音频的 CFG 均设为 4.0。 Salt++ 的初始化器和 rollout 模型使用 4 步网格 [ 1000,960,889,727 , 0 ] [1000,960,889,727,0]，推理时 CFG = 1 =1，在每一步预测干净的终点并将其重新加噪至下一个网格点。 该网格与训练噪声水平所采样的更细的八点网格（附录 A.5）都是在训练时使用的同一偏移 t ↦ 8 ​ t / ( 1 + 7 ​ t ) t\mapsto 8t/(1+7t) 作用下 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 均匀划分的像，因此前者是后者的子集。 在 960p 下，尺度递进系统使用 2 次低分辨率和 2 次高分辨率的生成器评估。 LTX-2 使用其 40 + 3 40+3 步的高分辨率路径。 OmniForcing 的评估方式是将其已发布的检查点直接应用于 960p 的 token 网格；这是一个分辨率外推诊断，而非分辨率匹配的训练基线。

paragraphs.en: Training starts from LTX-2 and keeps the velocity parameterization of Eq. 3 . Target noise levels are drawn uniformly on [ 0.003 , 1 ] [0.003,1] and reshaped by the shift t ↦ 8 ​ t / ( 1 + 7 ​ t ) t\mapsto 8t/(1+7t) , which concentrates supervision at higher noise; per-sample losses are weighted by w ⁡ ( t ) = exp ⁡ ( − 2 ​ ( t − 0.5 ) 2 ) w(t)=\exp(-2(t-0.5)^{2}) , which de-emphasizes both extremes. History noise levels are drawn from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.5 ) \mathcal{U}(0,0.5) , and the student layer ℓ s = 14 \ell_{s}=14 is aligned to EMA-teacher layer ℓ d = 34 \ell_{d}=34 of the 48-layer backbone. Projection heads are Linear--SiLU--Linear with a zero-initialized final layer, and the EMA decay is 0.99 0.99 . We set λ a = 0.16 \lambda_{a}=0.16 and λ rep = 0.05 \lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}=0.05 , and alternate CSF and clean teacher-forcing updates with equal probability. Optimization uses AdamW at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , dropped to 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} after 6k iterations, with 100 warmup steps, weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and gradient clipping at 10.0 10.0 , on 32 GB300 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Both routes then continue on generated histories with a shared self-forcing setup: the generator rolls out under the 4-step inference grid with a KV cache, one exit is sampled per iteration and shared across all blocks, and the fake score is trained on rollouts drawn from the same exit distribution. The two routes differ in what they can carry forward. The AR–AR route inherits both its generator and its fake score from the clean-prefix AR–AR checkpoint and keeps the causal CSF teacher as the real score, so the context-aligned objective continues unchanged for 1.2k iterations with teacher guidance still drawn from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 1.0 , 3.5 ) \mathcal{U}(1.0,3.5) . The TF-dCM route has no fake score to inherit, so both score models are initialized from LTX-2 and evaluated bidirectionally, giving the BI–BI configuration used by prior recipes; it runs for 2.4k iterations with guidance fixed at 3.0 3.0 . Optimization in both cases uses AdamW at learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for the generator and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for the fake score, with a cosine schedule, 100 warmup steps, weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and gradient clipping at 10.0 10.0 , on 12 GB300 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: The causal upsampler U ω U_{\omega} retains the architecture and weights of the released LTX-2 spatial upscaler and becomes causal through input windowing: to produce block [ s , e ) [s,e) it runs the network on latent frames [ max ⁡ ( 0 , s − 18 ) , e ) [\max(0,s-18),e) and crops the current block from the result. Restricting the receptive field in this way degrades the output, and we recover it by imitation. The teacher is the same released upscaler applied to the entire low-resolution sequence at once; the loss is a per-frame squared error in normalized latent space between each causal block output and the corresponding frames of the teacher output, averaged over non-padded frames. The inputs are online low-resolution rollouts from the frozen 4-step 480p generator rather than ground-truth latents, so U ω U_{\omega} is distilled on the latent distribution it encounters at deployment; each rollout draws its sampling grid with equal probability from the 4-call grid used at inference and from a finer 8-call grid. We train for 1.2k iterations with AdamW at learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , a cosine schedule with 100 warmup steps, gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and mixed precision, on the same training data as the preceding stages. This procedure only initializes U ω U_{\omega} ; scale-wise post-training then continues to update it through the high-resolution term of Eq. 10 .

paragraphs.en: [Shot 1][0.0s-5.0s]: A moody cinematic diner at night, seen in a locked medium close-up across a booth. A Caucasian woman in her early 40s with a short dark bob wears a charcoal coat and sits beneath soft amber light. Rain streaks the window behind her and a red neon glow remains blurred outside. Her face stays unobstructed and sharply focused. A white coffee cup sits near her left hand; both hands rest separately on the table with all fingers visible. She looks toward an unseen person opposite her, slowly tightens her fingertips around the cup without lifting it, and says in a low controlled voice, ”You weren’t supposed to find that letter.” Her eyes hold steady after the line. Rain, a distant refrigerator hum, and her voice are the only sounds.
paragraphs.zh: [镜头1][0.0秒-5.0秒]：夜晚一家氛围阴郁的电影感小餐馆，以固定的中近景隔着卡座拍摄。 一位四十岁出头的白人女性留着深色短波波头，身穿炭灰色大衣，坐在柔和的琥珀色灯光下。 雨水在她身后的窗上划出条纹，窗外的红色霓虹光晕保持模糊。 她的脸部始终无遮挡且对焦清晰锐利。 一只白色咖啡杯放在她左手附近；双手分开搁在桌上，所有手指均清晰可见。 她看向对面一个看不见的人，缓缓用指尖收紧握住杯子却不拿起它，并以低沉克制的声音说道：“你不该找到那封信的。”说完这句话后她的目光保持稳定。 雨声、远处冰箱的嗡嗡声和她的声音是仅有的声响。

paragraphs.en: [Shot 1][0.0s-5.0s]: In a minimalist fitness studio with a neutral grey wall, a mature Black man with a shaved head and a short grey beard stands on a black mat. The camera is locked in an eye-level medium shot, and broad soft lighting keeps his face, shoulders, and hands crisp without motion blur. He wears a maroon athletic shirt. Both hands begin open at waist height, palms angled inward and clearly separated. He brings them slowly upward by a few inches while maintaining direct eye contact and says in a calm, supportive voice, ”You don’t need more motivation; you need one smaller promise.” His hands stop and remain still as he gives a gentle nod. The studio is quiet except for his resonant voice and faint ventilation hum.
paragraphs.zh: [镜头1][0.0秒-5.0秒]：在一间以中性灰色墙壁为背景的极简健身房里，一位光头、留有灰白短须的黑人中年男子站在黑色垫子上。 相机固定为与视线齐平的中景镜头，柔和的大面积布光使他的面部、肩膀和双手清晰锐利，没有运动模糊。 他穿着一件栗色运动上衣。 双手起初张开置于腰部高度，掌心向内倾斜且明显分开。 他将双手缓慢上抬几英寸，同时保持直视镜头，用平静而有支持性的语气说道：“你不需要更多动力；你需要一个更小的承诺。”他的双手停下并保持不动，同时轻轻点了点头。 健身房里很安静，只有他浑厚的声音和微弱的通风嗡嗡声。
